connector.name: MCP by justdrop.ai
connector.registryDescription: Live, end-to-end encrypted, ephemeral file transfer between your AI agent and any device.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package justdrop-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.justdrop, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: JUSTDROP_ROOT
env.description: The only directory the server may read files from or save files into (root jail). Defaults to the working directory.

env.name: JUSTDROP_DEFAULT_EXPIRY_MINUTES
env.description: Room lifetime in minutes when a tool call doesn't specify one (1-1440, default 60).
